Planowana warstwa sterowania. Home Assis: The planned control layer. Home Assistant is meant to act as the integration engine, with HomeIntelCore providing one app for the home instead of a dozen manufacturer apps. Ordinary home control is meant to remain available without AI.
Planowana warstwa świadomości. Czujniki,: The planned awareness layer. Sensors, cameras and energy data are meant to feed a shared home history, analysed locally wherever possible.
Planowana warstwa rozumienia. Lokalny as: The planned understanding layer. A local assistant is meant to use the relations between data and answer in the context of the home, within the permissions of the person asking. The choice of models and hardware requirements have not been defined yet.
Planowana warstwa działania. Asystent pr: The planned action layer. The assistant proposes routines, learns recurring behaviour and performs previously approved actions within explicit limits. The autonomy levels described below belong to this stage.
Dalsza perspektywa. Kompletne urządzenie: Long term. A complete appliance combining data, integrations, backups and local AI, deployable by a non-technical person as well. Today the system is designed for a self-hosted homelab server. Hardware, performance and distribution remain to be verified.

Komponenty uruchomione w laboratorium pr: Components running in the project's lab on a self-hosted server. A test environment, not a deployed product.
Internet prowadzi do routera MikroTik RB: The internet feeds the MikroTik RB5009 router, which connects through a patch panel to the main CRS310-8G+2S+IN switch. The patch panel is passive: it only terminates the cabling and does no switching or routing. The switch distributes connections to the rooms and the planned access points, and a separate SFP+ link leads to the HomeIntelCore server / NAS. Port numbers and SFP+ modules have not been defined; the details button on a node shows what is settled.
Plan przewiduje dziewięć zakończeń RJ45: The plan calls for nine RJ45 endings and an SFP+ link to the server. The CRS310-8G+2S+IN has eight RJ45 ports and two SFP+ ports, and one port will be taken by the uplink from the RB5009. The medium of that uplink has not been chosen yet, so the budget depends on the scenario.
